what_changed: FTC proposed policy statement on applying the Section 5 deception prohibition to companies that market AI systems, concerning suppression of accuracy in AI systems.
rationale: Addresses how AI system vendors may be liable for deception; an AI servicing vendor is such a company, but the statement governs marketing of AI systems rather than a servicing behavior in the test.
